evidence.title: Claims Of China Being The First Country To Land On The South ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM debunked claims that China was the first country to land on the Moon's south pole, reiterating that India became the first country to land near the lunar south pole region with Chandrayaan-3.

outputs.notes_en: Other fact checks in the search results debunked viral fake media and animations claiming to show Chandrayaan-3 visuals, or unrelated pandemic claims, and were excluded.
